en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near-black
zh: 更新内置的 dataviz skill：接受 APCA 作为文本对比度度量（在要求 AA 合规时仍保留 WCAG 2 比值），在其调色板校验脚本中新增 `apca(text, background)` 函数，并说明彩色图表填充内的标签应使用白色还是近黑色
